summary: AI Concierge (AURA) backend sprint fully validated. Wrote 24 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_concierge.py covering ALL 11 backend items from the review request. 24/24 concierge tests pass. Full regression 78/78 (test_my_home 27 + test_trust_engine 23 + test_fintech_sprint 28). Grand total: 102/102 backend tests green. Frontend NOT tested (review_request says 'backend only'). Key validations: (1) SYSTEM_PROMPT + strict JSON schema enforced via _sanitize (bad urgency -> 'moyenne', confidence>100 clamped, invalid trade -> None, invalid next_action -> 'continue'). (2) initial_greeting() deterministic, no LLM call, correct schema. (3) _augment_safety deterministic keyword net: 'odeur gaz' and 'électrocuté' both surface level=urgence alerts even with empty model output, and dedup by message works. (4) Full session lifecycle: POST /start persists greeting turn, POST /message appends user+assistant turns and sanitizes state, POST /finish sets status=completed + final_summary and is idempotent (already_finished=true), POST /video adds video_placeholder=true + video_pending=true, GET /sessions returns last_message without turns, GET /{sid} returns full turns, DELETE /{sid} removes it. (5) Auth guards: foreign sid -> 404 (both GET & DELETE); message on completed session -> 400; unauth start/list -> 401; missing sid GET -> 404. (6) Multi-turn context works — two consecutive messages on same session_id return coherent follow-up (best-effort). Live-test: 'odeur gaz' triggered the deterministic urgence alert as expected. Video endpoint adds system turn correctly. NO regressions in trust engine, my_home, or fintech modules.

minor.issue: Voice transcription failure is silently swallowed (logger.warning only) — client receives no signal that Whisper failed and user_text is empty. Consider returning a soft 'voice_failed' flag in the response so the UI can surface a retry hint.

Update logic uses `state.get('confidence') or session.get('confidence')` which will overwrite a real 0 with the previous value (because `0 or X == X`). Very minor — 0 confidence is only the greeting state — but should use explicit None check for cleanness.

res.get('text') is called without checking `hasattr` first — if the SDK returns a non-dict/non-object, this will raise AttributeError inside the except path. Wrapped by outer try, so it just logs, but tighter typing would help.

critical_code_review_comments: services/concierge.py (~260 lines) is well-scoped: SYSTEM_PROMPT enforcing strict JSON, deterministic safety net (_augment_safety), full sanitizer (_sanitize) clamping every field. Service never touches the DB — router owns persistence. Clean separation.

Safety-net design is excellent: keyword triggers for gas/electricity fire cross-trade (safety > taxonomy) while other trades only fire when detected_trade matches. Dedup by message string prevents alert spam if the model already surfaced the same warning.
initial_greeting() being LLM-free is a smart product decision — instant UX on session open, no latency, no cost. Great pattern to reuse.

server.py grew to 2200+ lines; concierge routes now add ~140 more. STRONGLY recommend extracting concierge_router.py alongside the earlier fintech router refactor recommendation. Currently 6 concierge endpoints all inline.
Multi-turn memory relies on LlmChat's session_id — verified working. Each turn instantiates a new LlmChat with the same session_id; the SDK handles context under the hood. Good use of the library.

force_finish appends '...réponds avec next_action=finish...' to the SYSTEM prompt — as documented in the sprint note, this can drift to unrelated trades. Acceptable for now (LLM behavior, not a code bug), but a targeted 'Given the conversation history, summarize...' user message might be more reliable than a prompt suffix.

Sanitizer confidence clamp uses `int(ld.get('confidence') or 0)` — if the model returns confidence=0.5 as a float it works, but confidence='' would int-fail. A try/except around the cast would make _sanitize truly bulletproof.
Video endpoint marks video_pending but never clears it — no route to 'process video and clear pending'. Fine for the 'coming soon' architecture, but flag it so future work can add a follow-up event.
Session listing correctly uses `turns: {$slice: -1}` to avoid pulling large arrays. Great perf choice.
seed_data_creation: During tests: created ~3 short concierge_sessions on client.test@auxora.fr (each cleaned up via DELETE at end of its test class or after the finish test). One session runs through full lifecycle: start -> message('odeur gaz') -> video -> finish -> delete. Multi-turn memory test also created + deleted its own session. No stale data left in db.concierge_sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Concierge (AURA) backend is production-ready. All 11 backend items from the sprint review are validated by /app/backend/tests/test_concierge.py (24 tests). Unit tests cover pure helpers (deterministic — no LLM calls needed for safety net / sanitizer / greeting). API tests cover lifecycle, auth guards, and one real multi-turn LLM flow. The safety-net is bulletproof and independent of LLM output — this is the correct architecture for a life-safety feature. Frontend routes /concierge/[id] and /concierge/index were NOT tested this iteration (backend-only sprint). When frontend testing is requested, use testID='problem-button' on home to enter the concierge, verify greeting bubble on 'new' route, verify chip taps send messages, and check /concierge/index for history list. Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_concierge.py should be run alongside the other 3 regression files for any future concierge work.
